blurb: Guests visit the zoo to see diverse animal habitats and participate in educational programs. They can enjoy train rides, private animal encounters, and birthday parties with animal presentations. The zoo offers field trips aligned with school curricula and various special events.
extraNote: Party deposit $50 non-refundable, applied to admission cost · Party cancellation: 50% venue fee refunded if cancelled 14+ days before event; no refunds within 14 days · Party rescheduling allowed within one year without penalty · Animal encounters require check-in 10 minutes before; late arrivals cancelled with no refund · Check-in inside the Gift Shop for groups; train tickets purchased at Train Depot inside the zoo.
